title: ChunkAct: Action Chunking for Agentic Robotics
title_zh: ChunkAct：面向智能体机器人的动作分块方法

paragraphs.en: Agentic robotics places a large language model (LLM) agent in the robot control loop, where it composes perception, motion, and vision-language-action (VLA) tools under the guidance of a memory and thereby generalizes to new tasks without retraining. This generality comes at a steep price in efficiency. Every primitive requires a round of LLM reasoning over the full interaction history, so the cost of an episode grows with the number of primitives. We find this reasoning largely redundant: once a sub-goal is chosen, its primitives follow a routine already prescribed by memory. We present ChunkAct , which introduces action chunking to agentic robotics. Online, a single call launches a chunk of chained primitives, which executes autonomously and returns control only upon failure. Offline, ChunkAct compiles the memory into these chunks, so execution is memory-free at test time and the planner is reserved for decisions that require reasoning. LLM computation therefore scales with the number of decisions rather than the number of primitives. On LIBERO-Pro, ChunkAct improves task success by 5.0 points over the state of the art in agentic robotics while requiring 2.9 × \times fewer LLM calls, 4.4 × \times fewer input tokens, and 2.3 × \times fewer output tokens.

paragraphs.en: Agentic robotics has emerged as a new paradigm for robot manipulation ( Liang et al., 2023 ; Kumar, 2026 ; Fu et al., 2026 ; Tsui et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026c ; Jia et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026b ; Xu et al., 2026a ) . Rather than training a policy that maps pixels and language directly to motor commands ( Brohan et al., 2023a ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Black et al., 2024 ) , it places a large language model (LLM) agent in the control loop and equips it with perception, motion, and vision-language-action (VLA) tools, together with a memory of what has worked before. At each step, the agent observes the scene, consults the memory, reasons, and issues a single tool call ( Figure 1 , top). Because each task is composed by reasoning rather than learned from demonstrations, the agent handles new tasks without retraining and succeeds where end-to-end policies break down. For example, with no robot-specific training, GPT-6 Astra driven through a generic agent harness completes a real-arm pick-and-place task in 19 of 20 trials ( OpenAI, 2026 ; Menon et al., 2026 ) and ranks above every public policy on the RoboDojo benchmark ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , which illustrates the generalization this paradigm affords.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体机器人技术已成为机器人操作领域的一种新范式（Liang 等，2023；Kumar，2026；Fu 等，2026；Tsui 等，2026；Zhang 等，2026c；Jia 等，2026；Xu 等，2026b；Xu 等，2026a）。 与其训练一种将像素和语言直接映射到运动指令的策略（Brohan 等，2023a；Kim 等，2024；Black 等，2024），不如在控制回路中引入一个大型语言模型（LLM）智能体，并为其配备感知、运动和视觉-语言-动作（VLA）工具，同时赋予其关于过往有效方法的记忆。 在每个步骤中，该智能体会观察场景、查阅记忆、进行推理，并发出单个工具调用（图1，顶部）。 由于每个任务都是通过推理构成的，而非从演示中学习而来，因此该智能体无需重新训练即可处理新任务，并在端到端策略失效的情况下取得成功。 例如，在没有针对特定机器人进行训练的情况下，通过通用智能体框架运行的 GPT-6 Astra 在20次试验中有19次成功完成了真实机械臂的抓取与放置任务（OpenAI，2026；Menon 等，2026），并在 RoboDojo 基准测试中超越了所有公开策略（Zhang 等，2026b），这体现了该范式所具备的泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: However, this generalization comes at a steep price in efficiency. The planner acts through primitives, i.e., robot skills invoked as tool calls, each of which requires a dedicated round of LLM reasoning. Every such round reprocesses the full interaction history, and reasoning models further consume output tokens before responding ( Sui et al., 2025 ) . Consequently, the number of calls and output tokens scales linearly with the number of primitives in an episode, while input tokens scale quadratically ( Kapoor et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2026a ) , as illustrated in Fig. 1 Top. For instance, a single pick-and-place task requires 24.2 LLM calls and 2.2M input tokens on average, costing about $22 per episode with GPT-6 Astra and still $11 even with the cheaper GPT-5.5. 1 1 1 Estimated at OpenAI’s list API prices as of October 2026. As tasks grow longer, this overhead quickly dominates the cost of execution, hindering the scalability of LLM-based agents.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，这种泛化在效率方面付出了高昂的代价。 规划器通过基础操作执行任务，即作为工具调用被激活的机器人技能，而每项技能都需要一轮专门的 LLM 推理。 每一轮这样的推理都会重新处理完整的交互历史，并且推理模型在响应前还会消耗额外的输出标记（Sui et al., 2025）。 因此，调用次数和输出标记的数量会随着单期任务中基础操作的数量线性增长，而输入标记的数量则呈二次方增长（Kapoor et al., 2024; Kim et al., 2026a），如图 1 顶部所示。 例如，一个简单的抓取与放置任务平均需要 24.2 次 LLM 调用和 220 万个输入标记，使用 GPT-6 Astra 时每期成本约为 22 美元，即使使用价格较低的 GPT-5.5，成本仍有 11 美元。1 1 1 该估算基于 OpenAI 截至 2026 年 10 月的 API 列表价格。 随着任务变得越来越长，这种额外开销会迅速超过执行成本本身，从而阻碍基于 LLM 的智能体的可扩展性。

paragraphs.en: To address this inefficiency, we analyze the agent’s behavior and find that LLM reasoning is frequently redundant. Once a sub-goal is selected and its targets are localized, the subsequent primitives follow a fixed routine already encoded in memory, such that each additional call merely reproduces a decision that has already been made. Although a single read of memory suffices to capture this routine, the LLM tends to deliberate over each step and constantly returns to memory for guidance. Furthermore, the memory retrieval and LLM reasoning become less reliable as the context grows ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Laban et al., 2026 ) . This overhead could therefore be eliminated by compiling memory into generalizable action sequences that execute without the planner’s step-by-step involvement. This concept also echoes the action chunk Zhao et al. (2023) in robotics.
paragraphs.zh: 为解决这种低效问题，我们分析了智能体的行为，发现大型语言模型（LLM）的推理过程常常是多余的。 一旦子目标被选定且其目标被定位，后续的基础操作便会遵循已编码在记忆中的固定流程，因此每次额外的调用都只是在重复一个早已做出的决策。 尽管只需一次记忆读取即可捕捉这一流程，但大型语言模型却倾向于对每一步进行反复斟酌，并持续返回记忆以寻求指导。 此外，随着上下文内容增多，记忆检索和大型语言模型的推理可靠性也会下降（Liu et al., 2024；Laban et al., 2026）。 因此，通过将记忆编译为无需规划器逐步介入即可执行的可泛化动作序列，便可消除这种额外开销。 这一概念也呼应了 Zhao et al.（2023）在机器人领域提出的动作分块方法。

paragraphs.en: Building on this observation, we propose ChunkAct (Action Chunking for Agentic Robotics), which consists of two complementary components: chunked execution at test time and memory internalization offline. At test time, ChunkAct introduces action chunking to agentic robotics. It composes the primitives that realize a sub-goal into an executable chunk, which the planner invokes with a single call and which then runs to completion autonomously. This design confines the LLM to where reasoning is genuinely required: understanding the physical scene, diagnosing failures, and redirecting the plan. To support this, a failed chunk returns a typed exit that specifies the failed primitive along with an error log, providing the planner with structured feedback for recovery. In this way, LLM computation scales with the number of decisions rather than the number of primitives (See Fig. 1 Bottom). Offline, ChunkAct builds these chunks as generalizable routines with memory compiled into them. The parameters and procedural knowledge that govern each chunk are compiled from memory before deployment, making its actions inherently memory-conditioned. As a result, chunks run memory-free at test time, eliminating frequent memory retrieval and further improving the efficiency of the LLM.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这一观察，我们提出了 ChunkAct（智能体机器人动作分块技术），它由两个互补的组件组成：测试时的分块执行和离线记忆内化。 在测试阶段，ChunkAct 将动作分块引入智能体机器人领域。 它将实现子目标的原始动作组合成一个可执行的模块，规划器只需一次调用即可启动该模块，之后模块将自主运行至完成。 这种设计将大型语言模型的计算限制在真正需要推理的环节：理解物理场景、诊断故障以及调整计划方向。 为实现这一点，失败的模块会返回一个带类型的退出信号，其中包含失败的原始动作和错误日志，从而为规划器提供结构化的恢复反馈。 通过这种方式，大型语言模型的计算量随决策次数而非原始动作数量而扩展（参见图 1 底部）。 在离线阶段，ChunkAct 将这些模块构建为可泛化的程序，并将记忆编译到其中。 每个模块的参数和过程性知识在部署前会从记忆中编译而来，使其动作本质上受记忆条件约束。 因此，模块在测试时无需访问记忆即可运行，从而避免了频繁的记忆检索，并进一步提升了大型语言模型的效率。

paragraphs.en: To our knowledge, ChunkAct is the first LLM agent for robot manipulation that commits to a chunk of chained perception and control primitives per call rather than to a single primitive.

paragraphs.en: ChunkAct compiles memory offline into generalizable action chunks, enabling memory-free execution at test time and reserving the LLM for decisions that genuinely require reasoning.

paragraphs.en: Language models entered manipulation as planners that sequence a fixed repertoire of skills, grounded in affordances and closed by textual feedback ( Brohan et al., 2023b ; Huang et al., 2022 ) . Code as Policies turned the plan into a program over perception and control interfaces ( Liang et al., 2023 ) , and later work widened what the program could express with structured prompts, foundation perception, and value maps ( Singh et al., 2022 ; Huang et al., 2023a ; Huang et al., 2023b ; Mu et al., 2024 ) . A parallel line places a reasoning model above a learned policy rather than around it ( Belkhale et al., 2024 ; Shi et al., 2025 ; Physical Intelligence et al., 2025 ) . The two lines have converged in agentic robotics , where an LLM agent sits in the control loop, calls perception, motion, and VLA tools, and keeps a memory of what has worked ( Fu et al., 2026 ; Tsui et al., 2026 ; Kumar, 2026 ; Jia et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026c ; Xu et al., 2026b ; Xu et al., 2026a ) . All of this work is measured by what the agent can accomplish, and none of it addresses the cost of consulting the planner before every primitive, which has been approached only by caching plans for tasks seen before ( Zhang et al., 2026a ; Kim et al., 2026a ) . To our knowledge, we are the first to improve efficiency in agentic robotics systems by consolidating recurring call sequences into reusable action routines.

paragraphs.en: How many actions a policy commits to per decision is a design choice that trades reactivity against consistency and cost. Policies that query the model once per control step ( Brohan et al., 2022 ; Brohan et al., 2023a ; Kim et al., 2024 ) tie inference cost to control frequency and let errors compound between queries. Action chunking, introduced by ACT ( Zhao et al., 2023 ) and adopted by Diffusion Policy ( Chi et al., 2025 ) , predicts a short sequence of actions per inference, and VLA models have since built it into their action heads and tokenizers ( Black et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2025 ; Pertsch et al., 2025 ) . Subsequent work tunes the trade-off by interleaving chunks for closed-loop reactivity ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Black et al., 2026 ) , and world-action models extend chunked prediction from actions to future observations ( Du et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2026b ) . In all of these, a chunk is a short sequence of motor commands from a learned policy, and how much an LLM agent should commit to per decision has been asked only in text environments ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . To our knowledge, we are the first to explore action chunking in agentic robotics, where a chunk spans perception, control primitives, and internalized memory rather than motor commands .
paragraphs.zh: 一项策略在每个决策中承诺执行多少动作，是一个在响应性、一致性和成本之间权衡的设计选择。 每个控制步骤仅查询模型一次的策略（Brohan et al., 2022; Brohan et al., 2023a; Kim et al., 2024）将推理成本与控制频率绑定，并允许错误在两次查询之间累积。 动作分块由 ACT（Zhao et al., 2023）提出，并被 Diffusion Policy（Chi et al., 2025）采用，它每次推理预测一个短的动作序列；此后，VLA 模型已将其整合到其动作头和分词器中（Black et al., 2024; Kim et al., 2025; Pertsch et al., 2025）。 后续研究通过交错分块来调整这一权衡，以实现闭环响应性（Liu et al., 2025; Black et al., 2026）；而世界-动作模型则将分块预测从动作扩展到未来观测（Du et al., 2023; Wu et al., 2024; Kim et al., 2026b）。 在所有这些方法中，一个分块都是来自已学习策略的短运动指令序列，而大型语言模型智能体在每个决策中应承诺多少动作这一问题，此前仅在文本环境中被探讨过（Yang et al., 2026）。 据我们所知，我们是首次在智能体机器人领域探索动作分块的研究；在此领域，一个分块涵盖了感知、控制原语和内化记忆，而不仅仅是运动指令。

paragraphs.en: Memory lets an LLM agent improve without weight updates, and its forms differ in what is stored rather than in how it is used. Reflective memory stores trajectories or the lessons drawn from them and returns relevant entries to the prompt ( Park et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ; Packer et al., 2023 ) . Procedural memory stores what worked as code, from skill libraries ( Wang et al., 2023 ) to induced workflows ( Wang et al., 2024 ) and robot programs adapted to new contexts ( Kagaya et al., 2025 ; Woods and Seifi, 2026 ) . Robot harnesses keep rule cards and task records written by the planner itself ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) , transition conditions between subtasks ( Xu et al., 2026b ) , or a demonstration video navigated at a chosen granularity ( Anonymous, 2026 ) . In every form, the planner decides what to retrieve and when, reads it into context, and interprets it before acting, so the memory is consumed at test time and its value is bounded by the planner’s ability to use it ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Li et al. (2025) comes closest to breaking this pattern by distilling recurring spans into a datastore that is emitted rather than read, yet its chunks remain text. We are the first work to explore compiling agentic memory offline into physical action, producing executable action chunks that require no memory access at deployment.

paragraphs.en: We analyze the planner’s tool calls and reveal two sources of inefficiency. ❶ The planner conflates deciding with executing. Every primitive incurs a full round of reasoning, even though, once a sub-goal is fixed, the primitives that realize it are largely determined by the memory; the planner is thus invoked far more often than the task demands decisions. ❷ The planner spends most of its calls gathering information rather than acting. Only 20.5% of calls invoke an action primitive, while memory reads and perception account for 31.7% and 44.3%, respectively (See Fig. 2 ). Since ℳ \mathcal{M} is static across episodes, these reads retrieve the same knowledge again and again, inflating the context without informing new decisions. These two findings motivate ChunkAct , which brings action chunking to agentic robotics through offline action chunk building ( Section 3.2 ) and online action chunk triggering ( Section 3.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们分析了规划器的工具调用，并揭示了两种低效的来源。❶ 规划器将决策与执行混为一谈。 每个基础操作都会引发一轮完整的推理，尽管一旦子目标确定，实现该子目标的基础操作在很大程度上已由记忆决定；因此，规划器的调用频率远高于任务所需的决策次数。❷ 规划器的大部分调用都用于收集信息，而非采取行动。 仅有 20.5% 的调用触发了动作基础操作，而记忆读取和感知分别占到了 31.7% 和 44.3%（参见图 2）。 由于 ℳ \mathcal{M} 在各个回合中都是静态的，这些读取操作会反复获取相同的信息，导致上下文冗余，却无法为新的决策提供依据。 这两项发现促成了 ChunkAct 的提出，它通过离线动作分块构建（第 3.2 节）和在线动作分块触发（第 3.3 节），将动作分块技术引入智能体机器人领域。

paragraphs.en: The memory of an LLM agent already records the general, reusable success rules and and procedural context for tasks. ChunkAct compiles all memory once into executable chunk form rather than letting the planner re-derive it at every step ( Figure 3 (a)). Memory construction begins with a partition over task categories. A manipulation instruction decomposes into an ordered sequence of typed sub-goals, and the space of such types remains small even as the task set grows. For example, two types suffice to cover a broad range of tabletop manipulation: transport, which relocates an object onto or into a receptacle, and fixture, which actuates an articulated element of the scene. All memory entries pertaining to a given type, from general execution rules to task-specific records, are therefore consolidated into a single source and compiled into a unified chunk, parameterized by the object classes on which it operates.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 智能体的记忆已经记录了任务的通用、可重用的成功规则以及流程上下文。 ChunkAct 将全部记忆一次性编译为可执行的“块”形式，而不是让规划器在每一步都重新推导（图 3(a)）。 记忆构建始于对任务类别的划分。 一个操作指令会分解为一系列有序的类型化子目标，并且即使任务集不断扩展，这些类型的空间仍然保持较小。 例如，仅用两种类型就足以涵盖广泛的桌面操作：运输（将物体移动到一个容器上或内部）和固定（激活场景中可活动的部件）。 因此，与特定类型相关的所有记忆条目——从通用执行规则到任务特定的记录——都会被整合到一个单一来源中，并编译成一个统一的“块”，其参数由所操作的物体类别决定。

paragraphs.en: Compilation retains only the procedural knowledge that defines how a task type is executed: the ordering of stages, the primitive assigned to each stage, the stage-level parameters conditioned on object class, the fallback strategies to attempt when a stage fails, and the criteria used to verify each stage. The primitive assignment, for instance, preserves the division of labor recorded in memory, delegating contact-rich stages such as grasping or fixture actuation to the VLA policy and the remaining stages to analytic primitives. Conversely, any quantity unobservable at deployment time is excluded. Recorded coordinates and privileged simulator state are discarded, and all geometric quantities are re-estimated from live perception of the current scene. This decoupling allows a chunk to transfer to scenes whose layouts differ from those encountered during memory construction.
paragraphs.zh: 编译过程仅保留定义任务类型执行方式的过程性知识：包括各阶段的顺序、分配给每个阶段的原始操作、基于对象类别的条件化阶段参数、阶段失败时尝试的备用策略，以及用于验证每个阶段的标准。 例如，原始操作的分配保留了记忆中记录的分工，将需要频繁接触的阶段（如抓取或夹具动作）委托给 VLA 策略，其余阶段则交由分析型原始操作处理。 相反，任何在部署时无法观测到的量都会被排除在外。 已记录的坐标和特权模拟器状态会被丢弃，所有几何量都将基于当前场景的实时感知重新估计。 这种解耦使得一个模块能够迁移到布局与记忆构建期间所遇到的场景不同的环境中。

paragraphs.en: The resulting chunk is an executable routine that captures the recurring procedure of its task type. A single chunk covers every task of its type, with class-dependent content resolved by lookup within the chunk. The planner is thus relieved of both memory retrieval and step-by-step primitive selection at run time. During execution, each stage is verified before the next begins, and the library is compiled once and kept frozen.
paragraphs.zh: 由此生成的代码块是一个可执行程序，能够捕捉其任务类型中重复出现的流程。 单个代码块涵盖了其类型下的所有任务，其中依赖类的内容由在代码块内查找的方式确定。 因此，规划器在运行时无需进行记忆检索或逐步骤选基本操作。 在执行过程中，每个阶段在下一阶段开始前都会得到验证，而库则只编译一次并保持固定不变。

paragraphs.zh: 为了解决问题 ❷，ChunkAct 将记忆 ℳ \mathcal{M} 内化为可执行的代码块，从而在运行时实现无记忆的执行。

paragraphs.en: At test time the planner invokes chunks in place of primitives, through a single tool call ( Figure 3 (b) labels ChunkAct ). The instruction is parsed into its ordered sequence of typed sub-goals, each sub-goal selects the chunk of its kind, and the planner’s interface to execution narrows to two operations, grounding a target in the current observation and launching the chunks. An episode therefore begins with the planner interpreting the task and the scene, grounding the first target, and issuing one call, after which the chunks run the sub-goals until the task is complete without any further request to the planner. No memory is read along the way, since everything the planner would have retrieved has been compiled into the chunks, and the planner’s context holds only the instruction, the observations it has requested, and the exits it has received.
paragraphs.zh: 在测试阶段，规划器通过一次工具调用（图 3(b) 将其标记为 ChunkAct）来用“片段”替代基本操作。 指令被解析为一系列有序的类型化子目标；每个子目标都会选择对应类型的片段，而规划器与执行层的接口则缩小到两项操作：在当前观察结果中确定目标，并启动这些片段。 因此，一个流程始于规划器对任务和场景的解读、首个目标的确定以及一次调用的发出；此后，这些片段将执行子目标，直至任务完成，无需再向规划器提出任何请求。 在此过程中不会读取任何记忆，因为规划器原本需要检索的所有信息都已被编译到这些片段中；规划器的上下文仅包含指令、其请求的观察结果以及已接收的退出信号。

paragraphs.en: Chaining the stages under one call, rather than exposing each stage as a separate call, follows from where reasoning is actually needed. Compiling memory and perception into chunks removes the cost of retrieval and repeated observation, but a per-stage interface would still return control to the planner after every action, turning each step of execution into a round of deliberation. Most of these rounds involve no decision.
paragraphs.zh: 将各个阶段整合到一次调用中，而不是将每个阶段作为独立的调用暴露出来，这一做法源于推理实际上所需的环节。 将记忆和感知信息整合成块可以消除检索和重复观察的成本，但如果采用分阶段接口，每次执行动作后仍会将控制权交还给规划器，从而使得执行的每一步都变成一轮重新审议。 这些审议回合中，大多数并不涉及任何决策。

paragraphs.en: Once its target is grounded, the stages of a sub-goal follow a fixed order, so a successful stage already determines the next one and requires no reasoning to select it. A chunk therefore chains the stages directly and returns control to the planner only when a stage fails.

paragraphs.en: Control returns to the planner only when a chunk fails, and it does so through a typed exit. Every stage of a chunk raises its own error code, so the exit names the stage that failed and the reason it failed, such as a perception call that cannot locate its target, a policy call that loses the object, or a verification that cannot confirm the sub-goal, and it carries the error log with the robot state and fresh observations ( Appendix A ). The planner then re-perceives the scene from its true state, and chooses among three responses, namely grounding the target again and re-invoking the chunk, redoing a sub-goal whose verification failed, or falling back to the primitives for a situation the library does not cover. Each response is a decision that requires understanding the task and the scene, and none is a step of execution, so the planner is consulted at decision points and nowhere else.
paragraphs.zh: 只有在某个环节失败时，控制权才会返回规划器，且这一过程通过带类型的退出机制完成。 每个环节都会生成自身的错误代码，因此退出机制会指出失败的环节及其原因，例如感知调用无法定位目标、策略调用丢失了物体，或验证无法确认子目标；同时还会携带包含机器人状态和最新观测信息的错误日志（附录 A）。 随后，规划器会根据场景的真实状态重新进行感知，并从三种响应中选择其一：重新确定目标并再次调用该环节、重做验证失败的子目标，或在库中未覆盖的情况下回退到基础操作。 每种响应都是一项需要理解任务和场景的决策，而非执行步骤，因此规划器仅在决策点被调用，其他情况下则不会介入。

paragraphs.en: We examine how this design changes the role of the planner, from stepwise executor to sub-goal selector and failure handler.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了这种设计如何改变规划者的角色，使其从分步执行者转变为子目标选择者和故障处理者。

paragraphs.en: Taken together, the two stages redefine the role of the planner. In the per-primitive loop of Equation 1 , the planner serves as both reasoner and executor, treating every step alike regardless of whether it requires judgment. ChunkAct separates the two: execution is delegated to the chunks, while the planner retains only what cannot be compiled, namely understanding the task and scene and responding to failure. This separation reshapes both sides of the loop.
paragraphs.zh: 综合来看，这两个阶段重新定义了规划器的角色。 在方程 1 的预原语循环中，规划器同时充当推理器和执行者，无论某个步骤是否需要判断，都一视同仁地对待。 ChunkAct 将两者分离：执行工作委托给各个模块，而规划器仅保留无法编译的部分，即理解任务和场景以及应对失败。 这种分离重塑了循环的两侧。

paragraphs.en: On the input side, the dominant sources of context are removed. Memory is internalized in the chunks rather than retrieved online, and perception is performed within each chunk rather than requested before every primitive. The context thus stays compact across an episode, containing only the instruction, decision-time observations, and exits. On the output side, the unit of action shifts from a single primitive to a chained chunk. Each step a t a_{t} is either a chunk launch or a response to an exit, so the planner is invoked per decision rather than per action, and reasoning is spent only where it is required. Episode cost therefore scales with the number of decisions rather than procedure length.
paragraphs.zh: 在输入端，主要的上下文来源被移除。 记忆被内化到各个分块中，而非在线检索；感知也发生在每个分块内部，而不是在每个基本操作前单独请求。 因此，在整个回合中，上下文保持紧凑，仅包含指令、决策时刻的观察结果以及退出点。 在输出端，行动单位从单个基本操作转变为链式分块。 每个步骤 a_t 要么是启动一个分块，要么是对退出点的响应；因此，规划器按每次决策调用，而非每次行动调用，推理也仅在有需求时进行。 因此，回合成本与决策次数相关，而非与流程长度相关。

paragraphs.en: Benchmarks. We evaluate on two benchmarks from the LIBERO family. Our main experiments use LIBERO-Pro ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) , which perturbs the four LIBERO suites ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , Spatial, Object, Goal, and LIBERO-10, along objects, initial states, instructions, and environments. Following Zhang et al. (2026c) , we evaluate the instruction and initial-state perturbations, denoted instruction redirection (T) and position swap (S). Each of the resulting eight suite and perturbation combinations contains 10 tasks. As in that protocol, we run 10 seeds per task, so that each combination aggregates 800 episodes. We further use LIBERO-Plus ( Fei et al., 2025 ) benchmark, which varies the LIBERO tasks along seven axes: object layout, camera viewpoint, robot initial state, language, lighting, background, and sensor noise. As its 10,030 variants are too many to evaluate exhaustively, we run a single seed on every task under each of the seven perturbation axes, which covers the full range of perturbations at a tractable cost.
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试。 我们在 LIBERO 系列的两个基准测试上进行评估。 我们的主要实验使用 LIBERO-Pro（Zhou 等人，2025），该测试对四个 LIBERO 套件（Liu 等人，2023）——Spatial、Object、Goal 和 LIBERO-10——中的物体、初始状态、指令和环境进行扰动。遵循 Zhang 等人 （2026c）的方法，我们评估了指令和初始状态的扰动，分别称为指令重定向（T）和位置交换（S）。 由此产生的八种套件与扰动的组合中，每种都包含 10 个任务。 与该协议一致，我们对每个任务运行 10 个种子，因此每种组合总共会累积 800 个回合。 我们还使用了 LIBERO-Plus（Fei 等人，2025）基准测试，该测试沿七个维度对 LIBERO 任务进行变化：物体布局、摄像头视角、机器人初始状态、语言、光照、背景和传感器噪声。 由于其 10,030 种变体数量过多而无法进行全面评估，因此我们对每个任务在七个扰动维度下的每一种情况仅运行一个种子，这样既覆盖了所有可能的扰动范围，又保持了可管理的成本。

paragraphs.en: Task success performance. As shown in Table 1 , ChunkAct achieves the highest task success rate on LIBERO-Pro, outperforming both end-to-end VLAs and agentic robotic systems. It attains an overall success rate of 83.8%, exceeding the strongest prior method, Harness VLA, by 5.0 points. The perturbations in LIBERO-Pro, instruction redirection and position swap, require a policy to act on instructions and object layouts that differ from those seen in training, and end-to-end VLAs largely fail under them. This failure extends to π RLinf \pi_{\mathrm{RLinf}} , the checkpoint that ChunkAct invokes as its contact primitive, which trails ChunkAct by 43.8 points. Since the primitive alone does not generalize to these perturbations, whatever success an agent recovers must come from how it grounds the task in the current scene before the primitive is called. Placing an LLM planner above the VLA recovers much loss, as the agentic baselines show, yet Harness VLA stops at 78.8% despite sharing the same planner, primitive, perception, and memory with ChunkAct . The two systems differ only in how memory is used. Harness VLA retrieves memory at test time and relies on the planner to reinterpret past experience at every call, whereas ChunkAct compiles it offline into executable chunks that encode how each task succeeds. The gap therefore isolates the benefit of memory internalization.

paragraphs.en: Efficiency analysis. As shown in Table 2 , ChunkAct attains its higher success rate at a fraction of the LLM cost. The first two rows correspond to the Harness VLA and ChunkAct entries in Table 1 . Relative to Harness VLA, ChunkAct issues 2.9 × \times fewer LLM calls and consumes 4.4 × \times fewer input tokens and 2.3 × \times fewer output tokens, while improving success by 5.0 points. The third and fourth rows repeat this comparison with reasoning disabled, and the efficiency advantage of ChunkAct grows further. Both observations stem from memory internalization. Harness VLA spends most LLM calls on perception queries and memory reads, and each result is appended to the context, so the context keeps growing over the episode. paragraphs.en: Analyzing the LLM planner reasoning impact. As shown in Table 2 , ChunkAct remains robust when the reasoning of LLM planner is disabled, whereas Harness VLA does not. The task success rate of ChunkAct stays stable across reasoning settings, while Harness VLA degrades sharply once reasoning is turned off. This contrast reflects how heavily each system relies on the planner. Harness VLA depends on the LLM at every step: each call must interpret the retrieved memory, decide what to perceive, and issue the correct next action, so the errors of a weaker planner accumulate over the episode. ChunkAct instead decouples the LLM from the execution it does not need to perform. With memory already internalized into the chunks, the planner is consulted only for the remaining decisions, which leaves a weaker planner far fewer opportunities to fail.
paragraphs.zh: 分析 LLM 规划器的推理影响。 如表 2 所示，当 LLM 规划器的推理功能被禁用时，ChunkAct 仍然表现稳健，而 Harness VLA 则不然。 ChunkAct 的任务成功率在各种推理设置下保持稳定，而 Harness VLA 一旦关闭推理功能，其性能便会急剧下降。 这种对比反映了每个系统对规划器的依赖程度。 Harness VLA 在每一步都依赖于 LLM：每次调用都必须解释检索到的记忆、决定感知什么，并执行正确的下一步操作，因此较弱的规划器所引入的错误会在整个任务过程中不断累积。 相比之下，ChunkAct 将 LLM 与其无需执行的操作解耦开来。 由于记忆已被内化到各个片段中，规划器只需为剩余的决策提供建议，这使得较弱的规划器出现错误的机会大大减少。

paragraphs.en: Quantifying the LLM agent’s contribution. To measure how much the planner contributes within ChunkAct , the last row of Table 2 executes the chunks under a scripted driver that makes no LLM call. The chunks alone reach 57.5%, which corresponds to episodes in which the compiled routines succeed without intervention. The LLM in ChunkAct without reasoning therefore accounts for the remaining 22.5 points. This contribution comes from recovery: when a chunk fails, the planner is invoked to interpret the current scene and direct the next step, which a scripted driver cannot. The LLM thus serves not as a step-by-step executor but as a recovery mechanism invoked where the compiled routine falls short, which is why it adds substantial success at a small cost in calls and tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 量化 LLM 智能体的贡献。 为了衡量规划器在 ChunkAct 中的贡献程度，表 2 的最后一行在无需调用 LLM 的脚本驱动下执行了各 chunk。 仅靠这些 chunk 就达到了 57.5%，这对应于编译好的流程无需干预即可成功运行的情况。 因此，ChunkAct 中不包含推理功能的 LLM 贡献了剩余的 22.5 个百分点。 这一贡献源于恢复机制：当某个 chunk 失败时，规划器会被调用以解析当前场景并指导下一步行动，而脚本驱动则无法做到这一点。 因此，LLM 并非作为逐步执行者发挥作用，而是作为一个在编译流程不足时启动的恢复机制，这也是它能在少量调用和 token 成本下显著提升成功率的原因。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 follows a single LIBERO-Pro episode and shows how the planner’s eight calls are distributed over 22 seconds of execution. The planner is engaged at two points only. At the start it views the scene and launches a chunk, which grasps and lifts the can without further LLM request. During the move, however, the can slips out of the gripper, and the chunk terminates with a typed exit. It returns a hand-off block, a structured error report that adds context to the error code. The planner resumes from the true state of the scene rather than from its expectation of it, spends four calls re-pointing the can, and triggers ChunkAct again, which carries the can to the basket, places it, and finishes on its own once the environment reports success. The episode makes visible the division of labor that Table 2 quantifies. The planner is reserved for understanding, while the chunks handle execution. It plans the next action chunk from the scene, and re-plans when a chunk fails.
paragraphs.zh: 图4展示了一个LIBERO-Pro单轮次过程，并说明了规划器在22秒的执行过程中如何分配其八次调用。 规划器仅在两个时刻被启用。 开始时，它观察场景并启动一个Chunk，该Chunk无需进一步向LLM请求即可抓取并提起罐子。 然而，在移动过程中，罐子从夹持器中滑落，导致该Chunk以类型化的退出方式终止。 它返回一个移交块，即一份结构化的错误报告，为错误代码提供了上下文信息。 规划器基于场景的真实状态而非其预期状态重新开始，花费四次调用重新定位罐子，并再次触发ChunkAct；后者将罐子移至篮子中、将其放置好，并在环境报告成功时自行完成操作。 这一轮次过程清晰地展现了表2所量化的分工模式。 规划器专门用于理解任务，而各Chunk则负责执行操作。 它根据当前场景规划下一个动作Chunk，并在某个Chunk失败时重新规划。

sents.en: Figure 4 follows a single LIBERO-Pro episode and shows how the planner’s eight calls are distributed over 22 seconds of execution.
sents.zh: 图4展示了一个LIBERO-Pro单轮次过程，并说明了规划器在22秒的执行过程中如何分配其八次调用。

sents.en: The planner is engaged at two points only.
sents.zh: 规划器仅在两个时刻被启用。

sents.en: At the start it views the scene and launches a chunk, which grasps and lifts the can without further LLM request.
sents.zh: 开始时，它观察场景并启动一个Chunk，该Chunk无需进一步向LLM请求即可抓取并提起罐子。

sents.en: During the move, however, the can slips out of the gripper, and the chunk terminates with a typed exit.
sents.zh: 然而，在移动过程中，罐子从夹持器中滑落，导致该Chunk以类型化的退出方式终止。

sents.en: It returns a hand-off block, a structured error report that adds context to the error code.
sents.zh: 它返回一个移交块，即一份结构化的错误报告，为错误代码提供了上下文信息。

sents.en: The planner resumes from the true state of the scene rather than from its expectation of it, spends four calls re-pointing the can, and triggers ChunkAct again, which carries the can to the basket, places it, and finishes on its own once the environment reports success.
sents.zh: 规划器基于场景的真实状态而非其预期状态重新开始，花费四次调用重新定位罐子，并再次触发ChunkAct；后者将罐子移至篮子中、将其放置好，并在环境报告成功时自行完成操作。

sents.en: The episode makes visible the division of labor that Table 2 quantifies.
sents.zh: 这一轮次过程清晰地展现了表2所量化的分工模式。

sents.en: The planner is reserved for understanding, while the chunks handle execution.
sents.zh: 规划器专门用于理解任务，而各Chunk则负责执行操作。

sents.en: It plans the next action chunk from the scene, and re-plans when a chunk fails.
sents.zh: 它根据当前场景规划下一个动作Chunk，并在某个Chunk失败时重新规划。

paragraphs.en: Agentic robotics generalizes to novel tasks without retraining, but at a steep cost in efficiency. We identify two bottlenecks: the LLM planner reasons before every primitive, although the primitives of a sub-goal follow a recurring pattern, and most of its calls are spent on perception and memory retrieval rather than action. ChunkAct is the first work to introduce action chunking to agentic robotics, and it internalizes memory into executable chunks offline. The LLM is thereby decoupled from routine execution and engaged only where reasoning is genuinely required, which improves LLM efficiency significantly. On LIBERO-Pro, ChunkAct improves task success by 5.0 points over the SOTA method with 2.9 × \times fewer LLM calls, 4.4 × \times fewer input tokens, and 2.3 × \times fewer output tokens, and it transfers zero-shot to unseen tasks on LIBERO-Plus.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体机器人技术无需重新训练即可泛化到新的任务，但效率代价高昂。 我们识别出两个瓶颈：大型语言模型规划器在每次执行基本操作前都会进行推理，尽管子目标的基本操作遵循重复模式，且其大部分调用都用于感知和记忆检索，而非行动。 ChunkAct 是首个将动作分块引入智能体机器人技术的研究，它能在离线状态下将记忆内化为可执行的动作分块。 由此，大型语言模型被从常规执行中解耦，仅在有真正推理需求时才会介入，从而显著提升了其效率。 在 LIBERO-Pro 上，ChunkAct 相比 SOTA 方法使任务成功率提升了 5.0 分，同时大型语言模型调用次数减少了 2.9 × \times，输入词元减少了 4.4 × \times，输出词元减少了 2.3 × \times，并且能够零样本迁移到 LIBERO-Plus 上的未见过的任务。
